baseline.answer:
Good morning,

Installing the Bank of Mars certificate in Java is a one-time software/configuration request. Please submit this through the **Windows Software Installation – I need software or a license installed on my computer** service rather than requesting local administrator rights.

In the request, include:
- Your computer name
- The Java installation/JDK requiring the certificate
- The Bank of Mars repository and certificate details
- The relevant project and business justification
- Your manager’s name for approval

Group IT will perform the installation where possible. Temporary administrator access should only be requested if Group IT cannot complete the task.

? Alter the base XYZ Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.

? Install and execute any licensable software that is not free of charge and not provided or authorized by the XYZ/IT Infrastructure Department, with the exception of trial software that should only be used for evaluation purposes.

✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between GGT Group (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Licensed software for which a valid usage license agreement exists between a GGT Group Nominated End-User (licensee) and the Software Vendor (licensor), irrespective of who acquires the license.
✔️ Open-source software licensed under an approved OSI license (http://www.opensource.org/licenses/alphabetical) where:
✔️ software is provided free of charge for commercial use,
✔️ does not contain advertising banners,
✔️ does not send any statistical data to third-party companies

- It is explicitly forbidden to:
? Alter the base GGT Group system installation deployed on the user’s workstation.
? Stop, crash, or block any service that protects and manages the workstation (i.e. viruses and malware)
? Install and execute any licensable software

- Please confirm with your manager that local administrator rights do not conflict with any client requirements.
- Approved rights must be renewed after 12 months.
